person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index row supplies only the common name Arthur Alexander and Box 8, with no rank, middle initial, or unique identifier. Accessible official, institutional, newspaper, directory, and obituary searches did not establish a matching identity.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 8 for Arthur Alexander's full identity, personnel status, employer or occupation, and OSS chronology; require corroborating identifiers beyond the common name. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index row supplies Charles T. Alexander, LT USN, Box 8, and a private identifier. Exact-name, Navy, official, institutional, newspaper, directory, and obituary searches did not supply corroborating evidence for a specific namesake.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 8 to connect the private identifier to Charles T. Alexander's full Navy service, immediate pre-OSS assignment, and last civilian employer. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index row supplies Cletus S. Alexander, T-5, Box 8, and a private identifier. A 1940 draft-registration index for Cletus Stephen Alexander names the Federal Works Agency, but name and middle initial alone do not connect that candidate to the OSS row; no second corroborating identifier was found.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 8 to test the Cletus Stephen Alexander candidate against the private identifier and personnel chronology before accepting or rejecting the Federal Works Agency lead. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index row supplies Edna S. Alexander, P-2, and Box 8. Accessible searches returned uncorroborated historical and genealogical namesakes but no OSS, federal-grade, or dated-employment link.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 8 for Edna S. Alexander's full identity, P-2 duties, employer, and OSS entry chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index row supplies the common name Eileen Alexander, Caf-4, and Box 9 without a middle initial or unique identifier. A prominent British physical educator and ATS officer was rejected because the sources do not establish service in the U.S. OSS index context.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 9 for Eileen Alexander's full identity, Caf-4 duties, employer, and OSS chronology; do not conflate the indexed person with the British namesake. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
